{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent history shows persistent underestimation of true price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 5% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0), slightly increase forecast volatility to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For high sentiment volatility (>0.5), apply smoothing filter to reduce noise in short-term price jumps.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >10% over 3 consecutive days, shift forecast upward by 5-10% to align with trend.",
    "In low-sentiment periods, reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% to avoid overestimating market resilience."
  ]
}
